desc: Read input N, X, arrays A, B, P, Q.
Construct the permutation arrays for P and Q (0-indexed or 1-indexed consistently).
Find the cycle in P containing X. Store the boxes in this cycle.
Find the cycle in Q containing X. Store the boxes in this cycle.
Check if all red balls are in the red cycle of X. If any red ball is in a box not in C_R, print -1.
Check if all blue balls are in the blue cycle of X. If any blue ball is in a box not in C_B, print -1.
Determine R_boxes: if there is at least one red ball in C_R, R_boxes = C_R \ {X}, else empty.
Determine B_boxes: if there is at least one blue ball in C_B, B_boxes = C_B \ {X}, else empty.
Compute the size of the union of R_boxes and B_boxes.
